statement: Intel guided Q3 2026 revenue to a range of 15.8 to 16.8 billion dollars, with non-GAAP gross margin of 42.0 percent and non-GAAP EPS of 0.38 dollars.
why: Guidance whose low end sits near the quarter just reported, with margin guided up again, says Intel expects the AI-driven demand it just booked to hold.

impact.mechanism: Forward revenue and margin guidance reflects the order book the vendor can already see, supporting the demand track.

evidence.excerpt: Q3 2026 outlook given in the release: revenue guidance $15.8-$16.8 billion; non-GAAP EPS $0.38; GAAP EPS $0.31; non-GAAP gross margin 42.0%.

confidence.basis: Primary source: guidance stated in Intel official earnings release.

dispersion: Guidance is a range of 15.8 to 16.8 billion dollars; the recorded value is the stated low end, not a computed midpoint. This is total company revenue, not a DC-GPU-only figure.
